frame.name: map
frame.origin: stationary base_link center projected onto the floor

measurement_correction.basis: corrected direct front-plane remeasurement plus target-distance closure
measurement_correction.effect_on_derived_translation: same additive offset cancels in each midpoint calculation

survey.required_technique: steel tape or laser measure plus perpendicular square
survey.target: flat high-contrast vertical rectangle at least 0.10 m wide, intersecting the lidar plane, with its surveyed face/base point on each mark
survey.configuration_policy: one fixed target may be reused while the powered-down rover is manually repositioned; every fixed-map base pose must be surveyed and the rover must be motionless during capture
survey.coverage_identity: distinct target coordinates expressed in each surveyed base pose; target labels do not establish distinct coverage
one_snapshot_two_samples: lidar_range uses the reviewed horizontal center anchor and the target face coordinate
floor_projection uses the reviewed bottom-contact anchor and the same target face/base coordinate

fixed_target.basis: checkerboard face centered on the lidar scan origin at a direct measured 0.350 m before rover repositioning

camera_pitch_calibration.basis: reviewed floor-contact pixel at the 0.655 m diagnostic placement; retained value is -3.0 degrees

ambiguity_control.setup: An opaque vertical object was placed roughly 0.10 m in front of and slightly right of the fixed checkerboard so both lidar surfaces remained eligible at the visible boundary.

operator_checks: RVR power and motors unavailable; rover motionless at the declared surveyed map pose during each capture
if the rover is manually repositioned, record the new fixed-map x, y, and yaw and use the same values in launch and sample binding
record actual measured x, y, radial range, technique, uncertainty, surveyor, and UTC time rather than merely copying nominal coordinates
capture one stable paired snapshot and retain the complete rosbag for every placement
review both the horizontal center and bottom-contact pixels in every PPM
stop rosbag, camera, and lidar and verify prohibited nodes and serial owners are absent
